name: MCAP
summary: Open container format and libraries for timestamped, heterogeneous robotics logs, with embedded schemas and indexed access. Message serialization remains an explicit choice separate from the container.
why_it_matters: Give camera, IMU, pose and navigation-health adapters one portable recording to replay and inspect offline.
hackathon_notes: Start with samples/recording-replay: stdlib JSONL main path and a verified mcap 1.3.1 container round trip. The format preserves timestamps but does not fix clock offsets, frames or false ground truth. Code license MIT, read upstream LICENSE. Avoid installing a full robotics framework just to replay this example.

name: Rosbags
summary: Pure Python ROS 1 and ROS 2 bag readers, writers, converters and type system. The official source is on GitLab; this GitHub repository is its official mirror. It can operate without a ROS installation.
why_it_matters: Extract organiser-provided IMU and pose recordings into a small evaluation pipeline without first setting up ROS.
hackathon_notes: Use AnyReader to deserialize known pose/IMU topics, retaining message time, log time and frame ids. Missing custom message definitions need the right typestore; a bag conversion does not transform coordinate frames. Docs and Apache-2.0 LICENSE.txt checked 2026-11-07; not run in this hub. GitHub's NOASSERTION metadata is not a substitute for reading the license.

name: Rerun
summary: SDKs and viewer for recording and inspecting multimodal robotics data on synchronized timelines, including images, point clouds, transforms, trajectories and scalar signals; supports MCAP ingestion.
why_it_matters: Inspect the estimator trajectory beside sensor frames and navigation-health signals when a map alone cannot explain a failure.
hackathon_notes: Prototype with the Python SDK and local viewer. Define coordinate frames and clock domains before comparing tracks. Cache the viewer/package and test the actual target laptop offline. README and MIT/Apache license files checked 2026-11-07; viewer not run in this hub. Keep hosted-service terms separate from the open-source SDK licenses.
